metadata.purpose: Index high-specificity evidence that bears directly on a person's documented denominational position, while preserving the distinction between signed positions, recorded votes, committee service, and first-person explanation.
metadata.modeling_rule: Formal position evidence is stronger for identifying a documented view than network proximity or generic event participation, but no evidence type should be collapsed into a total ideological label. Committee membership alone does not prove agreement with every line of a report, especially where a report records internal disagreement. Aggregate votes are event-level evidence unless individual votes are actually published; non-signership on a minority report is not proof of a majority vote.

evidence_hierarchy.rule: A named signature on a formal report directly establishes support for the signed report position at that time, subject to any recorded qualification.

A recorded individual vote or signed protest directly establishes the recorded action, but not every broader theological inference someone might draw from it. Aggregate vote totals are not person-level evidence.
A named procedural registration directly establishes the recorded procedural position. It does not establish the person’s view on the underlying merits unless the record also states that view.
Use the speaker's actual stated position and preserve limits or qualifications rather than reducing the statement to a generic label.
Committee service on a consensus report establishes participation in producing the report. It does not prove agreement with every sentence or resolve internal alternatives unless the source says so.
Institutional service alone is not a substitute for a person's documented view.
Participation establishes the participation event only and must not be used as a proxy for agreement with every position associated with the event or network.

normalized_position_sources.coverage: 27 named minority-report signers plus named presenter and Assembly outcome
normalized_position_sources.important_boundary: The report explicitly says its signers represented a wide variety of positions and practices. Signership establishes support for study and the report's grounds, not support for female ordination.

normalized_position_sources.coverage: 8 named minority-report signers
normalized_position_sources.important_boundary: The eight signers explicitly argued that women reading Scripture or exhorting in public worship exercises the authority of the Word and is forbidden by 1 Timothy 2. No individual majority roll call is inferred.

normalized_position_sources.coverage: 34 named concurring minority-report signers, named presenter/supporter, and 427-446 Assembly defeat
normalized_position_sources.important_boundary: Signership establishes support for the proposed study committee and pastoral letter, not a specific position on female ordination or every disputed practice. The 427-446 vote is aggregate only.

normalized_position_sources.coverage: complete published committee roster plus report-level position boundaries and one first-person committee-member statement
normalized_position_sources.important_boundary: The published report says the committee reached an overwhelming consensus but also records two schools of thought on women teaching men; do not infer which school an individual member held without separate evidence.

normalized_position_sources.coverage: reviewed user-supplied transcript of first-person explanatory video
normalized_position_sources.important_boundary: Use McGreevy's explicit statements rather than attributing every committee-report sentence to her.

normalized_position_sources.coverage: formal protest signer roster
normalized_position_sources.important_boundary: The protest objected to specified language/action and must not be reduced to generic support for or opposition to Revoice.

normalized_position_sources.coverage: 7-member official roster plus 12 collective Preamble/Twelve-Statement positions; report contains no formal recommendations
normalized_position_sources.important_boundary: The report says the Preamble and Twelve Statements summarize the committee’s discussions and convictions, while explicitly declining to endorse every thought/expression in later member essays or bibliography resources.

normalized_position_sources.coverage: 28 verified minority-report signers plus separately modeled principal authorship/presentation and editorial roles
normalized_position_sources.important_boundary: Records minority-report signership only.

normalized_position_sources.coverage: 46 verified minority-report signers plus separately modeled presenter and drafting roles
normalized_position_sources.important_boundary: Records minority-report signership only.

normalized_position_sources.coverage: 200 corrected official recorded negative votes: 199 in the 49th GA roster plus TE Danny Morgan added by the 51st GA correction
normalized_position_sources.important_boundary: A recorded negative vote establishes the vote, not a complete account of the commissioner's rationale.

normalized_position_sources.coverage: formal protest signer roster
normalized_position_sources.important_boundary: Protest signership records objection to the PCA withdrawal action and should not be generalized beyond the protest's stated grounds.

normalized_position_sources.coverage: 207 recorded negative votes extracted directly from the official 48th GA minutes
normalized_position_sources.important_boundary: The immediately preceding 1349-443 tally was the motion to close debate, not the final adoption tally; each named negative vote establishes only the recorded vote on Recommendation 37.

normalized_position_sources.coverage: Trevor Laurence principal author/presenter; Derek Radney substantial editorial contributor; Matthew D. Fender minority presenter; Joe Cristman drafting-committee member
normalized_position_sources.important_boundary: Role evidence remains distinct from report signership and is attributed only to the named person and documented role.

normalized_position_sources.coverage: AIC report, O38 commendation, O37 majority/minority and GA actions, O29, O15 majority/minority and GA actions, and corrected amendment disposition
normalized_position_sources.important_boundary: Aggregate vote totals remain event-level evidence and never identify unnamed individual voters.

normalized_position_sources.coverage: 173 commissioners named in the official minutes as agreeing with the point of order and disagreeing with the Moderator’s ruling
normalized_position_sources.important_boundary: This establishes the procedural position only, not opposition to the study committee on its merits.

normalized_position_sources.coverage: Joseph Pipa named as protest presenter plus 28 commissioners explicitly listed as adding their names
normalized_position_sources.important_boundary: Preserve Pipa’s author/presenter role separately from the 28 added signers; do not silently call the added-signature roster 29 names.

normalized_position_sources.coverage: complete 10-member committee roster; Sections I-XI submitted by the entire committee with no dissent
normalized_position_sources.important_boundary: Consensus participation does not identify which side a committee member held on the unresolved duty-versus-wise-counsel question.

normalized_position_sources.coverage: 5 named signers of Man’s Duty to Protect Woman
normalized_position_sources.important_boundary: Establishes the signed duty-position report only, not a generic position on every issue concerning women.

normalized_position_sources.coverage: 4 named signers of Recommendations for the Wise Counsel of the Church
normalized_position_sources.important_boundary: The minority still counseled against women in combat; its dispute was whether the church could bind all consciences by declaring the conclusion a scriptural duty.

normalized_position_sources.coverage: 6 named majority-position report names; Recommendations 1-4 adopted by the 30th General Assembly
normalized_position_sources.important_boundary: Report signership is direct person-level evidence; the Assembly’s aggregate adoption is not an individual roll call.

normalized_position_sources.coverage: 4 named minority-report names; minority substitute defeated
normalized_position_sources.important_boundary: The four names establish the minority position; no unnamed commissioner’s position is inferred from the Assembly outcome.
